Nemohl jsem dosud odjeti ani do [USTI; neurčené místní jméno], ač mne již sestra [MICE; nevyložené slovo] [s netrpělivostí?; R05 S / L01 NETRPELIVOSTI] čeká. I have not yet been able to leave even for [USTI; unidentified place-like name], although the sister [MICE; unrendered word] already waits for me [with impatience?; R05 S / L01 NETRPELIVOSTI]. [We shall meet?; SHLEDANE SE] [therefore?; TIDIZ] only in [PRAZE; unidentified place-like name], to [which?; NAC] I look forward very much. [When?; K?Y] [will you come?; PRI?EDES], my dearest beloved? A thousand warm kisses and greetings from [PEPOUSE; unverified signature], who is constantly and longingly remembering.
